column1: Adds "Delete Permanently" to the order grid and the order page. The order is removed with its invoices, shipments, credit memos, payment, transactions, addresses, comments and tax rows. This cannot be undone and nothing is restored (no stock, no refunds, no reward points). Admin users also need the role resource Softaware > Order Tools > Delete Orders. Every deletion is recorded in the Deleted Orders Log.
